correctness.rationale: For every real t in [0,1/2], the truncation differences satisfy six coordinate and eight diagonal bounds. Every extreme point of their halfspace intersection is a signed permutation of (2,2(1-2t),0), and all such vertices are realized as actual differences. The diagonal six-vertex facet is centrally symmetric iff 1-2t=1/2, with endpoints excluded by triangular facets; the successful direction also has an explicit six-segment zonotope. The exact inball calculation gives min(2,4(1-t)/sqrt(3)) and all equality normals. Exact rational checker tests support the proof but do not replace it.

value.rationale: Difference bodies encode every directional width. The result exactly identifies a natural entire symmetrization family, proves a unique parameter where the nonzonotopal truncations yield a zonotope, gives six explicit generators and a sharp but distinct minimum-width transition with exhaustive equality normals. This constitutes a natural structural classification rather than a routine single-parameter substitution or a known-table recomputation.
